# Crystal Clean Services

> Family-run, fully insured window, gutter and fascia cleaning business, trading since 2008. Serves South Tyneside, South Shields, Jarrow, Hebburn, Cleadon, Boldon, Washington, Newcastle, Sunderland, Seaham and Murton in North East England.

## Services and starting prices
- Window cleaning (pure water, spot-free): from £10
- Gutter cleaning (ground-based vacuum system): from £80
- Fascia and soffit cleaning: from £70
Final prices depend on property size and condition. Quotes are free.

## Areas covered
South Tyneside, South Shields, Jarrow, Hebburn, Cleadon, Boldon, Washington, Newcastle, Sunderland, Seaham, Murton
